_comment: Copy this file to %AppData%\SubMailPersonal\integrations.json (Windows) or ~/.config/SubMailPersonal/integrations.json (Linux/macOS) and fill in your own service. The file is read from disk at runtime and is never committed. Set SUBMAIL_INTEGRATIONS_CONFIG to use a different location.

integrations.name: Dịch vụ tạo ảnh trên máy tôi
